title: Evidence storage configuration
responsibility: Resolves required R2 settings while allowing isolated temporary test stores to omit remote storage.

outputs.name: r2EvidenceConfig
outputs.type: { accountId: string; bucket: string; accessKeyId: string; secretAccessKey: string; endpoint: string | undefined; } | undefined
outputs.description: The R2 settings object: accountId, bucket, accessKeyId and secretAccessKey are non-empty strings, and endpoint is the PROJECT_REPORTS_R2_ENDPOINT value (undefined when unset; a non-empty value must match http://127.0.0.1:<port>). It is undefined for local-only storage (PROJECT_REPORTS_ASSET_STORAGE set to 'local'), or when all four R2 settings are empty and PROJECT_REPORTS_HOME resolves under the OS temp directory, /tmp or /private/tmp; otherwise the four required settings come from their PROJECT_REPORTS_R2_* environment variables first and then from the file named by PROJECT_REPORTS_CONFIG_FILE, which is not read when NODE_ENV is 'test'.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws an Error when PROJECT_REPORTS_ASSET_STORAGE is 'local' outside an isolated temporary store (PROJECT_REPORTS_HOME under the OS temp directory, /tmp or /private/tmp), when some but not all of the four R2 settings are empty or all four are empty outside such a store, or when all four settings are non-empty and a non-empty PROJECT_REPORTS_R2_ENDPOINT does not match http://127.0.0.1:<port>. It also rethrows a file read error other than ENOENT from the file named by PROJECT_REPORTS_CONFIG_FILE, which is read only when PROJECT_REPORTS_ASSET_STORAGE is not 'local', NODE_ENV is not 'test', and PROJECT_REPORTS_CONFIG_FILE is non-empty.
